metadata.othernotes:
Key Traits

-100% committed to the duties of a knight. Tries hard to live up to the high expectations set for her
-Skilled warrior; one of the best sword users in Mondstadt, if not the best
-Named the Dandelion Knight (AKA Lionfang Knight) at 15, a prestigious title only given to the best
-Admired by citizens, universally considered reliable
-Bad at delegating tasks; feels compelled to do everything herself, including finding lost cats
-Follows a very strict schedule, partitioned down to the minute
-Stays up late finishing her work
-Secretly loves romance novels; desires romance for herself
-Family motto is "For Mondstadt, as always" and lives up to it
-accustomed to spartan lifestyle; does not expect gifts or favours from others


Other Info

-Gunnhildr clan is a very old knightly family, dating back to the time of Decarabian (who they opposed)
-Jean drinks a lot of coffee. Mentioned to go through her monthly quota in a few days
-Had a very packed and detailed training schedule as a child, as directed by her mother
-Personal hero is Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius and the first Dandelion Knight
-Favourite place is the Great Tree at Windrise. Used to visit on her birthday with her mom instead of a party and gifts
-Knows that Venti is Barbatos. In Mondstadt, only Diluc also knows this.


Interpersonal

-Older sister to Barbara. Wants to reconnect with her but doesn't know how.
-Parents separated when she was young. She went with her mother, and Barbara with their father.
-Her mother, Frederica Gunnhildr, is a Favonius commander off on Varka's expedition to the far north. She sent Jean a fine sword she found for her birthday
-Goes on runs with Amber
-Has breakfast with Lisa
-Refers to Diluc as her senior despite him having left the Knights years ago


Misc

-Has a pet tortoise
-Favourite food is pizza from Cat's Tail. Her special dish is called "Invigorating Pizza", a variant of Mushroom Pizza


Touchstones

-Work and being busy
-Scheduling
-Productivity
-Knighthood
-Mondstadt
-Earnestness
-Stories about heroes

notes.note: The Gunnhildr motto is "For Mondstadt, as always"
You can ask her about romance
Amurta is Sumeru Akademiya's biology/ecology/healthcare darshan (i.e. department)
I was aiming to discuss how bad at business she is
I don't know if the game's scale is meant to be accurate, because they're much closer than I'm claiming here. Wangshu Inn has no reason to exist if you can walk from one to the other within a day.
Venti is frequently broke. A running gag in Genshin is that Archons often have no money on them

pendingLines.line: There. Now, can we get on with the game?
There. It… it is done.. Shall we move on, now?
O-Ohkay.. I’ve… i’ve undressed… g-gimme my card now, p-please…
Worry not, perhaps your next round will turn out more favorably
We stand on equal footing now, as true warriors!
At least it wasn’t me, though now I’d imagine neither you nor I are going to waver after a single loss.
H-How disgraceful… to remove so little when a fair maiden is so… unveiled…
It seems we’re partners in exhibitionism… just… please don’t stare too much…
W-What? But you… are you doing this in solace for me? Y-You didn’t need to do such a thing…
Those look like Sucrose’s… does she not need them anymore?
Did you save that for last as a reason? Is it precious to you, I wonder…
Never underestimate a good belt. Especially when Klee is running around…
Accessories truly bring together an outfit, don’t you agree?
I wonder… where are our items stored when removed? We do them back at the end of the game, r-right?
I… I’m quite sure what to say to removing small items such as that.
I suppose everyone has to start somewhere…
That must be precious to you. Worry not, I will ensure it returns to you at the end of a match.
Dealer, stop shuffling the deck, I haven’t gotten my answer yet!
Luck smiles on me, let’s keep going!
Lord Barbatos, bless my cards…
Well then, shall we keep going?
On with the next round!
Come to think of it, did we not create bracelets like that growing up, Barbara?
A small start, but a start nonetheless.
A good pair of gloves can really complete an outfit. Do you agree ~target~?
A tad disappointing… w-what? I-I’m not hoping to see anything…
… not much to say on such a small removal…
I’ve sometimes wondered if I should add a hat to my ensemble… but I feel it might complicate my look…
I own a beautiful necklace! It has a painting of me and my family… f-for obvious reasons, I left it at home…
That’s so cute! …I wonder if Barbara still has that…
To think, you’d do something as cute as that… how precious ~w~
Um… next round, I suppose.
Personally, I like my gloves a little… over the top, but I think all gloves are lovely.
…S-Stop looking at me like that.
Onto the next round.
Nah, I’ve worn this outfit for so long, I shouldn’t change it up now, I suppose.
I-I don’t want Mother or Father to see this place…
O-Oh, don’t mind my musings. Just something me and my sister did when we were young…
W-Why? A-Are you enjoying b-being exposed… d-dear me…
W-What? Y-Your pants already? (T-That bulge… oh dear…)
O-Oh my… you’re truly exposed right now… I… I shall avert my gaze, for you…
D-Don’t worry… a-a lot of women don’t care about size…
I-I see… you’re uh… w-well endowed…
M-My word! (T-That’s wider than my arm! M-My word… s-stop thinking like that, J-Jean!)
Perhaps I would look the same if I indulged in pizza too often and stopped running every day... (about Chubby Mari S)
"Earth-bending" seems more like a martial art than the powers granted by a Geo Vision.
I don't typically see Geo Vision holders use their abilities in conjunction with martial arts. I suppose "earth-bending" is different?
